tickets.subject: RAG index not loading
tickets.description: After running /index, the cache file exists but searches return no results. The .cache/rag_index.json file is created but seems empty.

comments.author: support
comments.text: Please check if the .cache directory has write permissions. Also verify that your PROJECT_ROOT environment variable is set correctly.

comments.author: user-001
comments.text: Fixed! It was a permission issue. Changed directory permissions with chmod 755 .cache

tickets.resolution: User granted write permissions to .cache directory. Issue resolved.

tickets.subject: Web UI connection timeout
tickets.description: When trying to access the web interface at http://127.0.0.1:8088, the connection times out after 30 seconds. Server starts successfully but doesn't respond.

comments.author: support
comments.text: Can you check if port 8088 is already in use? Try: lsof -i :8088 or netstat -an | grep 8088

comments.author: user-002
comments.text: Yes, found another process on port 8088. How do I change the port?

comments.author: support
comments.text: Currently investigating the best way to make port configurable. Temporary solution: kill the other process or modify PORT variable in web_server.py

tickets.subject: Authorization error in CLI
tickets.description: Getting 'Authorization header missing' error when using /tool commands. Web UI works fine, only CLI is affected.

tickets.subject: MCP server not starting
tickets.description: When running python -m progect_assistant.mcp_server, get ImportError: No module named 'mcp'. Fresh installation on Ubuntu 22.04.

comments.author: support
comments.text: You need to install the MCP package: pip install anthropic-mcp or pip install mcp

comments.author: user-003
comments.text: Installed via pip install mcp and it works now. Thanks!

tickets.resolution: User installed missing mcp package dependency.
